chapter_title: Concerning the Body: It was constructed after the Pattern of the Universe.
chapter_note: Core layer is dominant: systematic microcosm–macrocosm correspondences (body↔cosmic geography; five watch-stations; four bodily worlds with 7 rulers each; zodiacal body maps; demonic rulers causing illness). Clear later strata: (a) hagiographic dialogue frame (¶1, ¶30, ¶37); (b) an ethical/self-mastery application section explicitly keyed to the Elect and moral subduing (¶18–22), plus minor didactic asides inside otherwise core material (several MIXED cuts). No NT/Gospel overlay appears here.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic scene-setting with ‘apostle… among the church… congregation… disciples’: hagiographic compilation frame.

paragraphs.core_text: This whole universe, above and below, reflects the pattern of the human body; as the formation of this body of flesh accords to the pattern of the universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal microcosm–macrocosm axiom; cosmos→cosmos correspondence stated as structure, not exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: Its head is like the first-fruits of the five garments. And, from its neck down to the site of its heart, it resembles the pattern of the ten firmaments. And again, the heart accords to the wheel of the rotating sphere. And, from its heart down to its intestines (?), is like this atmosphere that extends from the sphere down to the earth. The [male] part of the body corresponds to this great earth. And also, from its intestines (?) down to its loins is like the three earths. And also, its shinbones to the pattern of the space in which the Porter stands. Its footsoles to the great earth upon which the Porter is stood; and the four fastenings that are under his feet. Its liver to the vessel of fire. Its flesh to the vessel of darkness. Its blood to the vessel of water.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Classic substrate-style correspondential mapping: body parts ↔ cosmic strata/structures, including numbered cosmography (five garments, ten firmaments, three earths) and named cosmic functionaries (Porter).

paragraphs.core_text: Now, this is how the small body corresponds to the macro-cosmos in its firmaments, in its orderings, in its mountains, its walls and its vessels.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed direct address/authorial aside: “as I have made clear to you!” (application/teaching-session voice rather than impersonal substrate exposition).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summary sentence continues the core correspondential register, but ends with a didactic second-person aside typical of later instructional delivery.

paragraphs.core_text: There exist five great camps in this great outer zone, of which the five sons of the Living Spirit are masters.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed presenter’s disclosure formula: “Once more, I reveal to you:” (dialogic/teaching-session voice).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core cosmological architecture (five camps; five sons of the Living Spirit) introduced, but prefaced by a later didactic formula.

paragraphs.core_text: So, in the first watch-station above, of which the Keeper of Splendour is master, on the battlement of all the works, is found his authority over the three heavens. Then the ones below him [ ... ... ] the great King of Honour.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic enumeration of cosmic watch-stations with named beings and jurisdictional degrees (three heavens): impersonal structural cosmology.

paragraphs.core_text: The second watch, of which the great King of Honour is master, his own authority (extends) over the seven firmaments beneath him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered degree structure (second watch; seven firmaments) in impersonal cosmological voice.

paragraphs.core_text: The third watch, of which the Adamant [is master, his authority] reigns from the firmament down below to the [earth]. [And he] invigorates, according to his authority, the sphere and the worlds of the atmosphere; and the other four worlds that are appointed on this earth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic governance/process description (invigorates sphere/atmosphere; four worlds) within system; no institutional pointing.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth watch, over which the King of Glory has power, is the three wheels. And his authority lies over the three earths upon the head of the Porter.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumerative cosmology: watch→three wheels; authority over three earths; named cosmic station (Porter).

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth watch is the watch over which the Porter is authoritative. Again, he is master, according to his authority, over this great earth he stands upon, and the four fastenings under his feet.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes fivefold watch schema; purely internal cosmic mechanics (Porter; earth; four fastenings).

paragraphs.core_text: Affliction has come about in these five watches from time to time.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Programmatic transition into cosmic disturbance narratives; still within cosmic system (no audience exhortation/institutional mapping).

paragraphs.core_text: So, in the watch of the Keeper of Splendour, Sin desired to spurt up towards the image of the Ambassador. Yet, they barred it from that place, and it fell back down in shame.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic conflict episode among beings/powers; ‘Sin’ functions as an agent within cosmological drama.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, an earthquake and treachery occurred in the watch of the great King of Honour, which the watchers who had arisen at the time and had [ ... ] they who were sent came down, until they were humbled.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Internal mythic event sequence (watchers; humbling) tied to the five-watch cosmography.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, in the watch of the Adamant, the abortions came to the earth and fashioned [the] figure of flesh.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mythic cosmogonic/anthropogonic event stated as process; remains within the cosmic narrative system.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, in the watch of the King of Glory, a commotion happened in these three earths above the Porter. The pathway was obstructed for the ascent of these three wheels; that of wind, that of water, and that of fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Degree mechanics (three wheels: wind/water/fire) obstructed—systemic cosmological process language.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, in the watch of the Porter, the fastenings beneath were laid bare and strained their chains. A great earthquake befell that place.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues internal cosmological disturbance motif tied to cosmic architecture (fastenings/chains).

paragraphs.core_text: [Like] these five watch-stations, which exist in this great [ ... these five] camps: this is also the case with this body. There are another five camps there, and the Light Mind is watching over them, and the new man who is with him.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed teaching-session aside and institutional identifier: “which I have recounted [to] you:” and “that the elect wear.” The ‘elect’ tag crosses from cosmic/body system into community categorization.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying correspondential move (five cosmic camps ↔ five in the body; Light Mind/new man as inner cosmic agents) looks substrate-like, but the Elect-marking is editorial institutional pointing.
Explicit ethical application keyed to ‘The elect person’ and self-discipline (‘control… guide… towards the good’): cosmos→community/moral practice.
‘Whoever will… subdue’ exhortational self-mastery; uses cosmic figure as moral analogue (application layer).
Moral control of lust/genitals framed as likeness of Adamant; application voice (‘Whoever will…’).
Ethical-ascetic discipline of food/fire within; second-person-indefinite exhortation (‘Whoever will… purify’).
Moral binding ‘with the chain of peace’ in the feet; analogy to Porter used for instruction rather than cosmological description.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, the teaching of wisdom, which circulates in that body: to the likeness of the Virgin of Light, who goes up and comes down in this zone, above and below.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Correspondence remains internal (bodily ‘circulation’ ↔ Virgin of Light’s cosmic motion); no institutional address.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, love and joy, faith and truth: they are to the likeness of these two light ships. For, the living soul should go up in them and become free through them; and it ascends from the abysses below and arrives at the heights above.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed moralizing clause: “in which the person should live” (ethical application tag).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core soteriological mechanics (light ships as ascent vehicles) are present, but the excised clause shows a later ethical/applicatory insertion.

paragraphs.core_text: There exist four worlds in this body of the flesh, and there exist countless times seven rulers in the body of the four worlds!
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed directive teaching-session preface: “Once more, understand this other (truth):”.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered structural schema (four worlds; seven rulers) is substrate-like; prefaced by later didactic address.

paragraphs.core_text: So, the first world is from its neck up; and also the seven rulers who are in this upper world are these: the two organs of sight, and the two of hearing, and the two of smell. The other one is the mouth, which is the organ of taste.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic microcosmic ‘world’ division with septenary organ-rulers; impersonal enumerative style.

paragraphs.core_text: The second world is from its neck down to its entire upper torso. And also, the seven rulers who are in this second world are: its two arms that accord to the pattern of its two ears, which occur in its first world above; and its two breasts that are to the pattern of its organs of smell; and the two eyes of its heart; and the gullet of the stomach between the two breasts, which in the chest is the pattern of the mouth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure correspondential mapping (arm↔ear; breast↔smell; etc.) within a numbered bodily-cosmological schema.

paragraphs.core_text: Once more, there exist seven rulers in the third world of the body, which are these: the fat, the lung, the spleen, the liver, the gall, and its two kidneys.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Septenary ‘rulers’ list in the third bodily world; impersonal structural enumeration.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, the fourth world below. There are another seven there of this same kind: its two buttocks (?), and its two testicles, and its two loins; and the member out of which the seed comes, that begets all the forms.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes fourfold bodily-world schema with sevenfold rulers; cosmo-biological generative language stays within system.
Dialogue attribution (‘enlightener… hearers’) is compilation frame; rule forbids it in core_text.

paragraphs.core_text: Aries and Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces; these are the twelve signs of the zodiac that occur in the worlds above, on the sphere. They are interlocked and bound on this turning wheel, the one in which they are [ ... ], fixed, and planted. And, regarding all these twelve signs of the zodiac, this is how they were appointed and made leaders [ ... ] on the sphere beneath the heaven that is the wheel of the stars.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the explicit didactic/pedagogical purpose clause addressed to the audience: “Now, they are appointed like this, they are thus, so that you can find the head of [ ... ] and you find the tail too [ ... ... ]”.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying astral cosmography is core-like (twelve signs; wheel of stars), but it trails into an audience-directed instructional aside.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, they occur like this, these that we have recited, one after another in this body. They are counted by order and number from the head to the feet. Its head is Aries. Its neck and its shoulders are Taurus. Its two arms Gemini. Its upper torso is Cancer. Its stomach is Leo. Its belly is Virgo. The vertical spine and its intestines (?) are Libra. Its genitals Scorpio. Its loins are Sagittarius. Its knees are Capricorn. Its shinbones are Aquarius. The soles of its feet are Pisces.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Direct zodiac→body vertical correspondence list: a hallmark correspondential substrate schema.

paragraphs.core_text: Behold, these are also distributed one after another. They exist in this body, as if turned to the side and bent to the pattern of the twelve signs of the zodiac. They too are thus, arranged one against another, head to tail, as they occur on the wheel [ ... ] up.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second schema description (side/bent; head-to-tail) continues technical correspondential exposition; ‘Behold’ is rhetorical but not institutional.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, they are counted by order and number of the body and all its members. Because from its head down to its hip shall count six to its left, and another six to its right.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed editorial narrator voice: “So, we have proclaimed that these are turned to the side, bent, and spread out;” (homiletic/reporting tone rather than schematic listing).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core content is a numeric/positional rule (six left/six right), but it is embedded in a later ‘we have proclaimed’ reporting register.

paragraphs.core_text: The six that are down its right are these that I will recount: the right temple is Aries; its right shoulder is Taurus; its right arm is Gemini; its right rib-cage is Cancer; its stomach is Leo; the right side of its reproductive organs are Virgo.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Right-side zodiac mapping continues the technical body–zodiac correspondence list (still internal, schematic).

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the other six about which we have spoken, which are to its left, in contrast they come from its hip to its head: its left [ ... ] is Libra; its left rib-cage is Scorpio; its left breast and left kidney is Sagittarius; its [left] elbow is Capricorn; its left shoulder is Aquarius; its left temple is Pisces. This is how the creator of the body himself has appointed them. He has [set] them in order and arranged them, one against its companion, head to tail.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the bilateral zodiac schema; closes with an internal-system ‘creator of the body’ ordering statement, not church/institutional application.
Brief speech-transition formula (‘Once more he speaks’) is hagiographic framing.

paragraphs.core_text: There exist many powers in this body. They are the house-dwellers who are made the leaders in it. There are eight hundred and forty times ten thousand rulers made chiefs in the human body! They are distributed and set firm, quartered according to house. The count and number of their houses is two hundred and ten times ten thousand.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed imperative/lesson-introduction: “Listen to this other lesson that I will proclaim to you. Understand that” (teaching-session voice).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying content is a technical numerological-demonic schema (rulers; houses; distribution) typical of cosmological catalogues, but introduced by later exhortative scaffolding.

paragraphs.core_text: When all these rulers come creeping and moving within the body, they will meet one another; and they shall beset and destroy one another, and [ ... ] in them there. When [ ... t/il]] they shall erupt from the body of the person who [will] die; and make putrid boils and sores and burning wounds in the body. Either they might have made him sick within; or else they might come forth upon his outer side. Those wounds shall first be squeezed and discharge their liquid, and empty out their pus, until they are squeezed [ ... ... ] and the suppuration forced out from the wound. Afterwards, their scars shall close over; and they are healed and obtain relief from the places that came out upon them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Demonic-physiological mechanics described as process (rulers moving/erupting/causing sores) without institutional exhortation: an internal-system cosmology of illness.
